scope: Balanced three-phase EMT teaching network derived from PGLib PJM5. Five buses, six independent per-phase pi lines, and one fixed-impedance load step.

source_data.attribution: IEEE 2010; source data F. Li and R. Bo, Small Test Systems for Power System Economic Studies

source_capacitor_initialization.candidate: Initialize the capacitor voltage and line/load inductor current to zero; give each ideal source its analytic right derivative at zero.
source_capacitor_initialization.native: Both actual native archived runs start with zero source and directly driven shunt capacitor currents.

expected_pattern.definition: For each phase d0=C_endpoint*dvsource/dt(0+) at the line end on bus 4, and the sum over those ends for sourced delivery. At electrical row k the expected candidate minus PSCAD difference is (-1)^k*d0. Ordinary currents expect zero difference.
expected_pattern.line_ports: Only the end at bus 4 of lines 14, 34 and 45 has nonzero d0. Keep all measured raw differences. Gate the discrepancy from the analytic pattern and adjacent-row mean current difference at every interval.

comparison.clock: Use matching original absolute electrical rows including zero, with no interpolation or shift. The load changes resistance at the right endpoint at 0.300 s.
comparison.pointwise: Compare all five-bus phase voltages, all line series and both signed port currents, all baseline resistor/inductor branch currents, source delivery and added branch currents. Exact resistance schedule. Limits are maximum absolute errors in SI units.
comparison.windows: On the frozen windows compare bus-2 phase RMS, three-phase signed real import from buses 1 and 3, and the added load consumption. Verify the PyCy cross-grid windows and raw bus voltage and series-current limits. Use both full native executions and preserve hashed original inputs and unshifted metrics.
